about: The birds' own moves (3.3 batch, lane B), built by scripts/ark-bird-moves.mts from AnimalDex docs/ark/signature-behaviours.json: a species has a move only where a row of its own stored text says it (the quote beside it), and its sentence for the live log is the row's line. mob: diving at a predator near them in turns. lure: the broken-wing display. tail: its constant tail movement. drop: its ducklings jump from the tree hole.

american-crow.quote: memory and mobbing make danger easier to track.

australian-magpie.line: {animals} are mobbing an intruder together, calling loudly
australian-magpie.quote: Group members mob intruders together, calling loudly

black-headed-gull.line: {animals} are rising together, screaming, and diving at an intruder
black-headed-gull.behaviour: colony rises together screaming and dives at intruders
black-headed-gull.quote: Colonies rise together, screaming, and dive at intruders, driving off many would-be raiders.

black-naped-oriole.line: {animals} are mobbing a crow that came near their nest
black-naped-oriole.behaviour: pairs mob crows and drongos near the nest
black-naped-oriole.quote: Pairs will mob crows and drongos that come near an active nest, well above their weight.

carrion-crow.line: {animals} are gathering to mob a bird of prey noisily
carrion-crow.quote: Crows gather to mob raptors and owls noisily.

common-green-magpie.line: {animals} are mobbing a danger with loud rasping calls
common-green-magpie.behaviour: pairs and family groups mob danger
common-green-magpie.quote: pairs and family groups are reported to mob danger with loud rasping calls.

common-myna.line: {animals} are gathering with loud alarm calls to mob a predator near the nest
common-myna.behaviour: gathers to mob predators near nest or roost
common-myna.quote: Mynas give loud alarm calls and gather to mob predators near the nest or roost.

eurasian-magpie.line: {animals} are mobbing an intruder as a group, chattering harshly
eurasian-magpie.quote: Magpies answer with harsh chattering alarm calls and mob intruders in groups.

great-tailed-grackle.line: {animals} are mobbing an intruder together with loud alarm calls
great-tailed-grackle.quote: birds mob an intruder together with loud alarm calls.

indian-pied-myna.line: {animals} are mobbing a predator with harsh alarm calls, then flying up together
indian-pied-myna.behaviour: flocks mob predators and fly up together
indian-pied-myna.quote: Flocks give harsh alarm calls, gather to mob a predator, and fly up together when one attacks.

northern-mockingbird.line: {aAnimal} is diving at an intruder near its nest and striking it
northern-mockingbird.behaviour: dives at and strikes intruders near the nest
northern-mockingbird.quote: Adults mob and dive at intruders near the nest, striking cats, dogs and sometimes people.

pied-butcherbird.line: {animals} are mobbing an intruder on their territory as a group
pied-butcherbird.quote: Territorial vigilance, mobbing and group defence can reduce those risks.

pied-crow.line: {animals} are mobbing a large raptor near their nest, diving at it again and again
pied-crow.behaviour: pairs mob large raptors diving at them repeatedly
pied-crow.quote: Pairs mob eagles, hawks and other large raptors that fly near the nest, diving at them repeatedly.

pied-fantail.line: {aAnimal} is scolding and diving at a far larger animal near its nest
pied-fantail.behaviour: parents dive at animals far larger near the nest
pied-fantail.quote: Parents defend the nest boldly, scolding and diving at animals far larger than themselves, people included.

red-vented-bulbul.line: {animals} are mobbing an intruder near their nest with harsh alarm calls
red-vented-bulbul.behaviour: pairs mob intruders near nest, then dive into shrubs
red-vented-bulbul.quote: Pairs give harsh alarm calls, mob intruders near the nest, and dive into dense shrubs.

red-winged-blackbird.behaviour: males dive at intruders, neighbours join mobbing
red-winged-blackbird.quote: Territorial males dive at intruders, and neighbouring males often join in the mobbing.

ring-billed-gull.line: {animals} are mobbing and diving at an intruder together at the colony
ring-billed-gull.behaviour: colony mobs and dives at intruders together
ring-billed-gull.quote: Intruders at a colony are mobbed and dived at by many birds together.

rufous-bellied-thrush.line: {aAnimal} is mobbing a predator near its nest with sharp, repeated alarm calls
rufous-bellied-thrush.behaviour: adults mob predators near the nest
rufous-bellied-thrush.quote: Adults give sharp, repeated alarm calls, dive into cover, and mob predators near the nest.

sooty-headed-bulbul.line: {animals} are gathering with loud chattering calls to mob a perched predator
sooty-headed-bulbul.behaviour: gathers to mob a perched predator
sooty-headed-bulbul.quote: Birds give loud chattering alarm calls and gather to mob a perched predator.

white-crested-laughingthrush.line: {animals} are mobbing an intruder with loud alarm calls
white-crested-laughingthrush.behaviour: flock mobs intruders or dives into cover
white-crested-laughingthrush.quote: The flock answers danger with loud alarm calls, mobs the intruder, or dives into dense cover.

yellow-legged-gull.line: {animals} are diving again and again at an intruder, striking with their feet
yellow-legged-gull.behaviour: colony dives repeatedly at intruders, striking with the feet
yellow-legged-gull.quote: Colonies answer an intruder with alarm calls and repeated dives, striking with the feet, while chicks crouch in cover.

yellow-vented-bulbul.line: {animals} are scolding harshly and mobbing a snake near the nest
yellow-vented-bulbul.behaviour: gathers to mob a snake or cat near the nest
yellow-vented-bulbul.quote: Adults give harsh scolding calls and gather to mob a snake or cat near the nest.

black-winged-stilt.behaviour: dives at intruders and feigns injury to lure danger from chicks
black-winged-stilt.quote: Adults fly out to meet intruders, calling loudly and diving at them, and may feign injury to draw danger away from the young.

blue-crane.behaviour: parents charge intruders and perform distraction displays
blue-crane.quote: Parents defend chicks by charging intruders and by distraction displays.

killdeer.line: {aAnimal} is faking a broken wing to draw danger away from its nest
killdeer.behaviour: broken-wing distraction display leading predators away from the nest
killdeer.quote: The broken-wing bluff bird. A shorebird that protects ground nests by drawing danger away with loud distraction displays.

southern-lapwing.line: {aAnimal} is fluttering on the ground, pretending to have a broken wing
southern-lapwing.behaviour: pretends to have a broken wing or leg to lure predators from the nest
southern-lapwing.quote: When a predator approaches its nest, the Southern Lapwing will often pretend to have a broken wing or leg, fluttering erratically on the ground a short distance away.

australasian-swamphen.line: {aAnimal} is flicking its tail, flashing the white underneath
australasian-swamphen.behaviour: flicks its tail, flashing the white undertail
australasian-swamphen.quote: White undertail flashed with each tail flick

carolina-wren.line: {aAnimal} is perched with its tail cocked upward

common-sandpiper.line: {aAnimal} is walking with its rear end bobbing almost without pause
common-sandpiper.behaviour: rear end bobs almost continuously as it walks
common-sandpiper.quote: The rear end bobs almost continuously as the bird walks, even when it pauses to pick prey.

eastern-phoebe.line: {aAnimal} is pumping its tail down and up on its perch
eastern-phoebe.behaviour: pumps tail down and up while perched
eastern-phoebe.quote: Pumps its tail down and up repeatedly while perched

grey-wagtail.behaviour: hops rock to rock in fast streams pumping long tail
grey-wagtail.quote: hops from rock to rock in fast streams, pumping its long tail as it snaps up insects where water meets land

house-wren.line: {aAnimal} is perched with its short tail cocked upward
house-wren.quote: The short tail is often cocked upward

masked-water-tyrant.line: {aAnimal} is fanning and flicking its tail
masked-water-tyrant.quote: Frequently fans or flicks its tail

oriental-magpie-robin.line: {aAnimal} is foraging with its tail raised
oriental-magpie-robin.behaviour: upright posture with raised tail while foraging

pied-fantail.line: {aAnimal} is swivelling restlessly and fanning its tail on a low perch
pied-fantail.behaviour: restless swivelling and tail-fanning on low perches
pied-fantail.quote: Restless swivelling and tail-fanning on low perches

western-yellow-wagtail.line: {aAnimal} is wagging its tail without a pause

white-rumped-shama.line: {aAnimal} is cocking and fanning its tail
white-rumped-shama.quote: Habit of cocking and fanning the tail

australian-wood-duck.line: {aAnimal} is leading ducklings that dropped from the tree hollow to water
australian-wood-duck.behaviour: ducklings drop from the tree hollow and are led to water by both parents
australian-wood-duck.quote: soon after hatching the ducklings drop from the hollow and are led to water and grass by both parents

bufflehead.line: {aAnimal} duckling is jumping from the tree hole to follow its mother
bufflehead.behaviour: ducklings jump from the tree hole a day or two after hatching
bufflehead.quote: Ducklings jump from the hole a day or two after hatching and follow her to water.

cotton-pygmy-goose.line: {aAnimal} is leading its ducklings from the tree hole to the lily beds
cotton-pygmy-goose.behaviour: ducklings jump down from a tree cavity and are led to the lily beds
cotton-pygmy-goose.quote: Ducklings jump down and are led to the lily beds within a day of hatching.

lesser-whistling-duck.line: {aAnimal} duckling is dropping from its tree nest to the ground below
lesser-whistling-duck.behaviour: ducklings drop from a tree nest to the ground or water
lesser-whistling-duck.quote: Ducklings hatched in a tree nest are reported to leave by dropping to the ground or water below.

mandarin-duck.line: {aAnimal} duckling is jumping down from a high tree cavity
mandarin-duck.behaviour: ducklings jump down from a high tree cavity soon after hatching
mandarin-duck.quote: The species nests in tree cavities that may be ten metres or more above the ground, and the ducklings leave by jumping down shortly after hatching.

muscovy-duck.line: {aAnimal} duckling is jumping from a tree cavity to follow its mother
muscovy-duck.behaviour: day-old ducklings jump from a tree cavity to follow the mother
muscovy-duck.quote: Wild Muscovies nest in tree cavities several metres up, and the day-old ducklings jump to the ground to follow their mother to water.
